## apiome arazzo {#arazzo}

List, show and validate the Arazzo workflows a revision stores.

```text
apiome arazzo [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

Subcommands: [`list`](#arazzo-list), [`show`](#arazzo-show), [`validate`](#arazzo-validate).

## apiome arazzo list {#arazzo-list}

List the Arazzo workflows a revision stores.

Reads GET /v1/workflows/{tenant}/versions/{version_id}, or the catalog route with --catalog. The table counts each workflow's steps and how many resolved to an operation; --json prints the REST response (every workflow with its steps).

Exit codes: 0 listed (an empty table when the revision holds no Arazzo document); 2 bad flags, or the project, version or catalog item is unknown; 1 server or network error.

```text
apiome arazzo list [OPTIONS]
```

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--project` | text |  |  | Project UUID or slug (with --version). |
| `--version` | text |  |  | Version UUID, slug or label (with --project). |
| `--catalog` | text |  |  | Catalog item UUID; reads its latest revision unless --revision. |
| `--revision` | text |  |  | Catalog revision UUID (with --catalog). |

## apiome arazzo show {#arazzo-show}

Show one stored Arazzo workflow and its ordered steps.

Reads GET /v1/workflows/{tenant}/versions/{version_id}/workflows/{workflow_id}; with --catalog the workflow is picked from the catalog route's list. Each step shows its target, its resolution state (resolved, unresolved, not_applicable or parse_error) and the operation it resolved to; --json prints the workflow with its revision and declared sources.

Exit codes: 0 shown; 2 bad flags, or the revision or workflow is unknown; 1 server or network error.

```text
apiome arazzo show [OPTIONS] WORKFLOW_ID
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `WORKFLOW_ID` | text | yes | The workflow's Arazzo workflowId. |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--project` | text |  |  | Project UUID or slug (with --version). |
| `--version` | text |  |  | Version UUID, slug or label (with --project). |
| `--catalog` | text |  |  | Catalog item UUID; reads its latest revision unless --revision. |
| `--revision` | text |  |  | Catalog revision UUID (with --catalog). |

## apiome arazzo validate {#arazzo-validate}

Validate an Arazzo document, or the workflows a revision stores.

With FILE, checks the document against the Arazzo JSON Schema for the version it declares (1.0.x or 1.1.x) — no server call. With --project/--version or --catalog instead, reads the stored workflows and fails when a step's operationRef / operationId is unresolved or could not be parsed, or when a source description is missing; each problem is printed on stderr.

Exit codes: 0 valid; 7 invalid document, or unresolved steps or missing sources; 2 bad flags, an unreadable file, or an unknown revision; 1 server or network error.

```text
apiome arazzo validate [OPTIONS] [FILE]
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `SOURCE` | text |  | Arazzo document to check (.yaml, .yml, .json, a URL, or - for stdin). |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--project` | text |  |  | Project UUID or slug (with --version). |
| `--version` | text |  |  | Version UUID, slug or label (with --project). |
| `--catalog` | text |  |  | Catalog item UUID; reads its latest revision unless --revision. |
| `--revision` | text |  |  | Catalog revision UUID (with --catalog). |
